subject.title: fix(cron): honor explicit announce delivery on system-event jobs

question: Should an unpinned `systemEvent` with explicit routable announce delivery implicitly become an isolated, model-backed `agentTurn`, or must callers explicitly select the isolated agent-turn contract?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but the branch changes the meaning and execution boundary of a currently rejected input; source-level tests cannot establish the intended user-facing API semantics.

options.title: Keep explicit session semantics
options.body: Preserve the current rejection and improve the error or CLI guidance so callers create an explicit isolated `agentTurn` when they want channel delivery.

options.title: Adopt implicit conversion
options.body: Accept the shorthand, document that it creates an isolated agent run, and require real scheduled-delivery proof for the announced result and target.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit session semantics
recommendation.body: Preserve the current rejection and improve the error or CLI guidance so callers create an explicit isolated `agentTurn` when they want channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the current owner of cron payload and delivery semantics; available review context does not safely identify that person.
